It is also known as Medyarasyana ghrita. It is very effective for calming children with mental illness. sections.introduction:
Kushmanda ghrita is a medicated preparation in which ghee is used as a base. This ghee is infused with various herbal drugs having its phyto active principles. It acts as a rejuvenator to both body and mind. It enhances cognitive functions and improves memory. It nourishes health, intellect, immunity and longevity. According to Ayurveda it boosts Dhii (intellect), dhriti (retention power) and samriti (memory). 
 Classical Indication 
 According to classical texts, Kushmanda ghrita is indicated in vata predominant dosha among all (vata, pitta and kapha). It is mentioned by Acharya Vagbhata and also in Bhaishjyaratnavali texts. Some of classical indications of Kushmanda ghrita are as following- 

 Apasmar roga (psychosis) 
 Buddhi vardhak (boosts intelligence) 
 Vani, swar vridhi (improves speech)
sections.ingredients:
There are only three ingredients for preparation of Kushmanda ghrita- 

 Kushmand ( Benincasa hispida ) – 18 prasth/ 3200g 
 Mulethi/ Yashtimadhu ( Glycyrrhiza glabra ) – 16 tola/ 192g 
 Cow’s Ghee – 1 prasth/400g 

 Benefits Of Ingredients 
 The benefits of ingredients are given as following- 

 Kushmand – It boosts memory, intellect and overall health of a person. It is very effective in dullness in children due to undeveloped brain and seizures. It also strengthens the respiratory system and heals damage caused by chronic bronchitis. It is a rich source of calcium, proteins and vitamins (vit. B, C) so helps in boosting immunity. It is used in all types of psychological disorders. It acts as a rejuvenative for the mind so used for managing depressive illness. 
 Yashtimadhu – It helps in removing vitiated vata and pitta dosha. It improves blood circulation to the brain and normalizes pitta disorders. It has strong anti-oxidant properties and acts as a brain tonic. It is a very potent stress busting and memory enhancing herb. It acts as an antidepressant and improves the quantity, quality of circulating blood. It reduces inflammation and removes all toxins from the body. 
 Cow Ghee – It acts as nectar for the brain, it boosts all neurological functions that controls conscious and subconscious movements. It improves decision making power, prevents dementia and Alzheimer like conditions. It boosts immunity and helps in growth, repair of brain cells. 

 Method Of Preparation 
 The steps for preparation of Kushmanda ghrita are given as following- 

 Firstly collect all the drugs mentioned above and wash them properly. 
 Make kalka (paste) of the kalka dravya i.e. yashtimadhu in a clean stainless steel vessel. 
 Then add cow ghee to the kalka prepared and mix it properly. 
 Then extract swaras or decoction from kushmand in a vessel. 
 Add decoction to the kalka-ghee mixture, stir the solution continuously and mix it well. 
 Cook the solution obtained on mild fire and reduce it till it remains in quantity of ghrita. 
 Filter the ghrit obtained, store it in an airtight glass container and keep away from direct sunlight.
